product_overview: GitHub User Finder is a single-page React application that lets users search any GitHub username and instantly view the user’s public profile details and recent public repositories. It uses the public GitHub REST API with no authentication required.
core_goals: Search for a GitHub username and submit the query
View a GitHub user’s profile information after a successful search
Browse the user’s most recently updated public repositories
See clear validation and result states when a search is empty or a username cannot be found
Reset the app back to an empty state after an error

features.name: Username Search
features.description: Allows users to enter a GitHub username and submit it to look up profile data.
user_flows: Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a GitHub username into the search field -> Submit the search form -> See the app begin loading the user data
Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a GitHub username into the search field -> Press Enter to submit the search -> See the app begin loading the user data
Type a username into the search field -> Clear the entered text -> Submit the search form -> See an inline validation message for missing input
See an inline validation message -> Start typing a username again -> See the validation message clear

features.name: User Profile Card
features.description: Displays the searched GitHub user’s public profile information after a successful lookup.
user_flows: Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a valid GitHub username into the search field -> Submit the search form -> Wait for loading to complete -> See the user profile card with avatar, username, and stats

Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a valid GitHub username into the search field -> Submit the search form -> Wait for loading to complete -> See the user profile card with display name, bio, and location when available
Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a valid GitHub username into the search field -> Submit the search form -> Wait for loading to complete -> Open the GitHub profile link from the username

features.name: Recent Repositories
features.description: Shows up to six of the searched user’s most recently updated public repositories.
user_flows: Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a valid GitHub username into the search field -> Submit the search form -> Wait for loading to complete -> Scroll to the recent repositories section -> See a grid of up to six repositories

Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a valid GitHub username into the search field -> Submit the search form -> Wait for loading to complete -> Scroll to the recent repositories section -> Open a repository link in a new tab

Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a valid GitHub username into the search field -> Submit the search form -> Wait for loading to complete -> Scroll to the recent repositories section -> See a fallback message when the user has no public repositories

features.name: Error and Reset States
features.description: Shows user-facing errors for empty input or missing users and lets the user return to the initial state.
user_flows: Open the app and see the empty state -> Submit the search form without entering a username -> See an inline error message for empty input -> Start typing again -> See the error clear

Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a non-existent GitHub username into the search field -> Submit the search form -> See an error message that the user was not found -> Choose to try again -> Return to the empty state

Open the app and see the empty state -> Type a GitHub username into the search field -> Submit the search form -> See a loading state -> Encounter an error state for the search -> Choose to try again -> Return to the empty state

features.name: Search GitHub user
features.description: Find a GitHub profile by username and render profile details
user_interactions: Type a GitHub username into the search field
Wait for loading indicator to complete
View profile name, username, avatar, and stats

features.name: View recent repositories
features.description: Show up to six recently updated repositories for the searched user
user_interactions: Search for a valid GitHub username
Open repository links in a new tab

features.name: Error and retry states
features.description: Show meaningful errors for invalid users or network problems and allow reset
user_interactions: Click retry/reset action to return to idle state
